findings.text: The null_handles docstring carries changelog prose: it states what the legend once did wrong ('the legend here once showed the axis hollow and used its own cross glyph, so it contradicted the marks it was naming', lines 105-107) where the repository rule requires a comment to state the mechanism rather than the bug that motivated it. The commit body at d26094ba8 already owns that history. Rewrite to the mechanism - a hand-built handle reproduces the glyph by hand and can drift, whereas capturing the artist the painter created makes the legend's glyph, fill and size the objects the panel was drawn with - which is the reason the function is shaped this way. Low severity; the code is correct and no reader is misled.

The derivation above TIE_BOOKED_CURRENT_REL states the bound is 'the larger gap plus that measured grid noise' (line 2720): the larger measured gap 1.59% plus the measured grid noise 0.118% is 1.71%, but the constant landed is 0.02. The 0.29 points above the derived sum are a margin the comment does not state, while the node brief asked for the tightened bound to carry 'a stated margin for its measured noise'. State the margin (or set the constant to 0.0171 with the noise floor asserted) so the comment and the value reconcile. Follow-on only - the bound is conservative and honest, so the check still refuses to admit the gap.
